diagnosis: The whiteboard CRDT state export route retrieves the complete binary Yjs document state from Redis using the boardId path parameter. It does not verify whether the authenticated user has read access to the requested whiteboard. An attacker can dump full collaborative whiteboard state vectors containing proprietary diagrams, wireframes, and notes belonging to rival teams.
